description: Get the configuration for adding a named MCP server (for example Notion, Supabase, Sentry, Postgres or a browser) to a given client. Returns the config, what the user must supply (a sign-in or keys), and who publishes the server. Where a vendor publishes its own server, that one is returned.

client.description: The user's MCP client: cursor, claude-desktop, claude-code, vscode, zed. Any other name gets the common mcpServers JSON.

name.description: The product or job, for example Notion, Supabase, browser automation.

name: stork_install
title: Set up an MCP server
